 Premier League on TV Today: Villa vs City on TNT, Chelsea vs Spurs on Sky
 Aston Villa vs Man City is live on TNT Sports at 12.30pm UK time, Chelsea vs Spurs on Sky Sports at 5.30pm, and Arsenal vs Everton and Coventry vs Fulham aren't shown live at 3pm.
 AR Arjun Rao 
 Fri 23 Oct 2026 
 2 min read 
 Comment 
 Chelsea Manchester City Tottenham Hotspur 
 Photo: Jacek Stanislawek / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0 
 Today is Saturday 24 October, and the Premier League is on two channels. Aston Villa vs Man City kicks off at 12.30pm UK time on TNT Sports, and Chelsea vs Spurs follows at 5.30pm UK time on Sky Sports. Arsenal vs Everton and Coventry vs Fulham, both at 3pm, aren’t shown live in the UK because of the Saturday blackout.

 Aston Villa vs Man City, 12.30pm on TNT Sports
 The early game at Villa Park is on TNT Sports 1 (and TNT Sports Ultimate), and listings also show it streaming on HBO Max. Erling Haaland is fit for City. Kick-off is 12.30pm UK time. Our Villa vs City TV page has the full viewing options.
 Chelsea vs Spurs, 5.30pm on Sky Sports
 Sky has the evening game on Sky Sports Main Event and Sky Sports Premier League, according to Sky’s football schedule . Palmer is fit for Chelsea and Spurs are without the banned Bentancur. Kick-off is 5.30pm UK time. More on the Chelsea vs Spurs TV page .

 Why Arsenal vs Everton isn’t on TV
 The two 3pm kick-offs, Arsenal vs Everton at the Emirates and Fulham’s trip to Coventry, fall on a Saturday afternoon, and UK rules stop live Premier League games being shown in that window. Neither is shown live on UK TV. Arsenal also go into it without Saka. Details are on the Arsenal vs Everton TV page .
 Sunday’s Premier League games on TV
 The clocks go back at 2am on Sunday, so Sunday kick-offs are GMT. Sky’s listings put all five games on Sky Sports:
 2pm: Crystal Palace vs Newcastle, Sky Sports+
 2pm: Hull vs Brentford, on Sky Sports
 2pm: Liverpool vs Brighton, Sky Sports Premier League ( TV page )
 2pm: Man Utd vs Bournemouth, Sky Sports Main Event ( TV page )
 4.30pm: Sunderland vs Leeds, Sky Sports Main Event and Sky Sports Premier League
 The full list is on our Premier League on TV this weekend page . Channels can change, so check Sky’s guide on the day.

 Quick questions
 What channel is Villa vs City on? TNT Sports 1, at 12.30pm UK time.
 Which Premier League games are live today? Two: Villa vs City at 12.30pm and Chelsea vs Spurs at 5.30pm, both UK time.
